name: cyclin D2
pathways: G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle

function.text: CCND2 encodes G1/S-specific cyclin-D2. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity and cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity. It participates in negative regulation of apoptotic process and G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to megalencephaly-polymicrogyria-polydactyly-hydrocephalus syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: CCND2 rearrangements, often involving immunoglobulin regulatory elements, occur in a subset of cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphomas. Rearrangement-associated deregulation should be distinguished from an isolated CCND2 sequence variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
Gene-level alteration context supported by primary literature; pathologist review needed.
